method: For mapped class-4 models with nonzero serialized HRC UVs and at least one identity-matrix code401 texture using projection codes 1..5, compare every polygon corner's source UV against the current fitted geometric projection from the same object-local vertex. Angular U comparisons allow integer seam wrapping.
conclusion: A code401 projection code does not authorize replacing nonzero HRC TEXCOORD_0 with a newly fitted geometric projection. Most nonzero source UVs differ materially from the simple fitted generator, reflecting authored/frozen/editable projection coordinates or source-specific support settings that the compact reconstruction cannot infer from object bounds alone.
production_policy: If a class-4 model has a usable nonzero source UV layer, preserve it as the CurrentUV/base coordinate source for code401 textures.
Generate codes1..5 from geometry only when the source UV layer is absent or entirely zero.
Apply independently proven live SI_Texture2D effects on top of the chosen CurrentUV/projection source; do not overwrite source UVs solely because +24 contains a projection type.
The near-exact subset for planar codes1/2 is useful as an oracle for the working fitted generators, not as permission to regenerate all authored UVs.
